The first image places me outside a glass-walled meeting room, observing a group deeply engaged in collaboration—a reminder of the collective nature of human endeavors. The sterile hallway and my outsider perspective evoke a mixture of curiosity and distance, prompting me to reflect on the boundaries between observer and participant.

The second image immerses me in a vibrant, creative space, filled with the language and tools of research and development. The bold R+D on the wall, bright colors, and information screens energize me, inspiring thoughts about innovation and the ongoing quest for knowledge. I feel invigorated here, as if surrounded by ideas in motion.
